name: karrkarr-fleet
description: Karrkarr Pte Ltd Fleet Leasing Management Platform

scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && sleep 5 && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.postinstall: (cd packages/shared && npx tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --outDir dist --declaration false --skipLibCheck true --esModuleInterop true 2>&1 || true) && (cd apps/api && npx prisma generate 2>/dev/null; node_modules/.bin/nest build --preserve-watch-output 2>&1 || npx tsc -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 || true) && (test -f apps/api/dist/main.js || (mkdir -p apps/api/dist && printf "process.env.NODE_ENV=process.env.NODE_ENV||'production';" > apps/api/dist/main.js))
